source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 10Animated Blood, Fantasy ViolenceGamesThe Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of TimeReleases 11/5/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - The Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of TimeAnimated Blood, Fantasy ViolenceLoadingWatch the latest trailerThe battle for Hyrule beginsThe evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the Hero of Time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.The battle for Hyrule beginsThe evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the Hero of Time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.The legend reborn for a new generationEnjoy completely overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, and symphonic orchestral music. You can also jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda™ series!12345678Active gallery item: $i of $t.Gear up for funAdventure in style with this special edition Nintendo Switch 2 system.Learn more Available 11/05/2026Exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Publisher notification(s):Get a digital wallpaper as an early purchase bonus!Purchase the digital version of the game before Nov. 23, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PT and you can get a Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary digital wallpaper as an early purchase bonus. The wallpaper is available in several formats for different screen types, and you can download it through the My Nintendo link that will be sent to the email associated with your Nintendo Account after the promotion period ends.Get more out of your adventure with ZELDA NOTES on the Nintendo Switch AppGet a little extra support on your quest with ZELDA NOTES—a game-specific service found in the Nintendo Switch App* on compatible smart devices. See your accomplishments for the day, take on the challenge of finding in-game locations based on images, and even play an ocarina on your smart device!Tap any existing Legend of Zelda series amiibo for in-game extras Get in-game extras to help you on your adventure by tapping any Legend of Zelda series amiibo™ figure**. If you tap the new Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo figures (coming in 2027), you’ll get in-game masks that evoke a retro graphical style! source.title: Hasbro Games™ Junior Collection
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 9GamesHasbro Games™ Junior CollectionReleases 11/6/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLoadingPlay Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr. Customize your avatar, unlock rewards, and enjoy local multiplayer fun for up to 4 players.Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!3 CLASSIC GAMES IN ONE: Play Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr.FUN FOR EVERYONE: Kid-friendly rules that are easy to learn and play fast.LOCAL MULTIPLAYER PARTY: Play together with up to 4 players on one console.CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR: Unlock fun new looks and cosmetic rewards as you play.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)1 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)GameShareLocalNintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
